8.7.1. iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathiter.areaIter¶

iLock_Geography.geo_algorithms.pathiter.areaIter(path, railyard, types=None)¶

Iterator over areas of user type in types along path in railyard.

Parameters:
  • path (IPath) – The path along which areas are iterated.
  • railyard (IRailyard) – The railyard containing the areas that are iterated.
  • types (Iterable(str) | str | none) – The user types that are the subtypes of the base type Area. Note that a string argument will be, interpreted as a 1-tuple, not as a character-iterable. An argument of None will be interpreted as “no restriction”, i.e. all user subtypes of base type Area are considered.
Return type:

Iterable(IGraph)
Returns:

An iterator returning the areas (of user type in types) along path in railyard.
